meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查文档是否符合写作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保文档遵循统一的写作指南
copy.tagline_en: Check docs for writing guidelines compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure docs follow a writing handbook

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会先联网获取最新的写作规范，然后读取你指定的文件，逐一检查里面的写作风格、用语等是否符合规范，最后用“文件名:行号”的格式报告发现的问题。
howto.when: 当你说“检查我的文档”、“审核写作风格”或“审阅散文”等关键词，或者要求对照写作手册检查页面时触发。

say.text: 检查我的文档是否符合写作规范。
say.note: Claude会获取最新规则并检查。

say.text: 审阅这个页面的措辞和语气。
say.note: Claude会检查页面的写作风格。
Claude会读取指定文件并报告问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches the latest writing guidelines, reads specified files, checks them against all rules, and outputs violations in "file:line" format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", or similar requests for writing guideline compliance.

say_en.text: Check my docs for writing guideline compliance.
Review the tone and style of this page.

say_en.note: Claude reads the file and reports issues.
